evaluation.use: Apply one exact profile to one exact subject and collect every declared outcome.

validation.use: Evaluate declared validation criteria and emit a Validation Receipt.

schema_conformance.use: Assert only that an exact machine artifact satisfies an exact closed schema under a complete applicable profile.

conformance_vocabulary.non_inference_rule: Validation PASS does not imply conformance; schema or identity-contract conformance does not imply implementation or runtime conformance; no conformance scope implies admission.
